subject.title: Expose maxMissedJobsPerRestart and missedJobStaggerMs in cron config

question: Should public cron config expose restart catch-up control as raw max/stagger knobs, an explicit skip/freshness policy, or no new public config?
rationale: The implementation gap is clear, but new cron config keys are a long-lived compatibility contract and the current internal knobs do not implement the reporter's desired disable/skip behavior.

options.title: Design explicit missed-run policy
options.body: Add a global or per-job skip/freshness policy that preserves current defaults while letting user-facing jobs skip stale restart catch-up.

options.title: Expose narrow global knobs
options.body: Publish max/stagger controls only after documenting zero-limit behavior and making clear that stagger reduces rate pressure rather than deciding run relevance.

options.title: Keep controls internal
options.body: Decline new config for now and rely on narrower catch-up bug fixes plus documentation of current restart behavior.

recommendation.title: Design explicit missed-run policy
recommendation.body: Add a global or per-job skip/freshness policy that preserves current defaults while letting user-facing jobs skip stale restart catch-up.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the original internal restart catch-up controls and is the strongest available owner for the public config/product decision.
